sources.snippet: End-to-End Data Infrastructure for AI Development High-quality, ethically sourced data is the backbone of powerful AI. sources.title: Home - ATLAS Umoja AI
sources.snippet: Each country, in its own identity ATLAS Umoja AI is a shared framework that each country can use to shape and build its own AI model. One that's based on its local language, dialects and culture. All on a timeline that suits them.
